items.question: Trong câu "All four titles — business owner, Product Owner, product manager, project manager — concern deciding where a product or project goes.", từ "concern" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All four titles — business owner, Product Owner, product manager, project manager — concern deciding where a product or project goes.", what does "concern" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to be about, to relate to
items.explanation: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (động từ): liên quan đến. Ở đây "concern" = liên quan đến, nói về; nghĩa khác là "làm lo lắng" (be concerned about). Danh từ: a concern (mối lo).
items.explanationEn: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (verb): to be about, to relate to. Here "concern" means to be about; its other sense is to worry someone (be concerned about). Noun: a concern.

items.question: Trong câu "They overlap, and every company defines them differently.", từ "overlap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They overlap, and every company defines them differently.", what does "overlap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to partly cover the same area
items.explanation: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (động từ): chồng lấn lên nhau. "Roles overlap" = các vai trò có phần trách nhiệm trùng nhau. Danh từ: an overlap between A and B.
items.explanationEn: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (verb): to partly cover the same area. "Roles overlap" means their responsibilities partly coincide. Noun: an overlap between A and B.

items.question: Trong câu "They overlap, and every company defines them differently.", từ "define" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They overlap, and every company defines them differently.", what does "define" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to state exactly what something is
items.explanation: define /dɪˈfaɪn/ (động từ): định nghĩa, xác định. "Define a role" = xác định phạm vi của một vai trò. Danh từ: definition (định nghĩa).
items.explanationEn: define /dɪˈfaɪn/ (verb): to state exactly what something is. "Define a role" means to state what it covers. Noun: definition.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequences of confusion are very real", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequences of confusion are very real", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way to fix a problem
a result, often a bad one
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒnsɪkwəns/ (danh từ): hậu quả. "The consequences of X" = hậu quả của X. Cụm hay gặp: as a consequence (do đó), face the consequences.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒnsɪkwəns/ (noun): a result, often a bad one. "The consequences of X" are its results. Common: as a consequence, face the consequences.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequences of confusion are very real", từ "confusion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequences of confusion are very real", what does "confusion" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a state of not being clear
items.explanation: confusion /kənˈfjuːʒn/ (danh từ): sự nhầm lẫn. Động từ: confuse (làm nhầm lẫn); "get confused" = bị nhầm lẫn, như tiêu đề "Why these four roles get confused".
items.explanationEn: confusion /kənˈfjuːʒn/ (noun): a state of not being clear. Verb: confuse; "get confused" means to be mixed up, as in the heading about the four roles.

items.question: Trong câu "Two people each believe they decide, producing contradictory direction.", từ "contradictory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two people each believe they decide, producing contradictory direction.", what does "contradictory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contradictory /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪktəri/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn nhau. "Contradictory direction" = chỉ đạo trái ngược nhau. Động từ: contradict (mâu thuẫn, phản bác).
items.explanationEn: contradictory /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪktəri/ (adjective): opposing each other. "Contradictory direction" means instructions that conflict. Verb: contradict.

items.question: Trong câu "Two people each believe they decide, producing contradictory direction.", từ "produce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two people each believe they decide, producing contradictory direction.", what does "produce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: produce /prəˈdjuːs/ (động từ): gây ra, dẫn đến. Ở đây "produce" = gây ra một kết quả; nghĩa khác là "sản xuất" hàng hóa trong nhà máy.
items.explanationEn: produce /prəˈdjuːs/ (verb): to cause, to bring about. Here "produce" means to cause a result; its other sense is to manufacture goods.

items.question: Trong câu "Two people each believe they decide, producing contradictory direction.", từ "direction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two people each believe they decide, producing contradictory direction.", what does "direction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: direction /dəˈrekʃn/ (danh từ): định hướng, chỉ đạo. "Give direction to a team" = định hướng cho đội; nghĩa khác "directions" = chỉ dẫn đường đi.
items.explanationEn: direction /dəˈrekʃn/ (noun): guidance on what to do. "Give direction to a team" means to guide it; "directions" can also mean route instructions.

items.question: Trong câu "Nobody is accountable when the product misses its goal.", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nobody is accountable when the product misses its goal.", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm giải trình. "Be accountable for X" = chịu trách nhiệm (và phải giải trình) về X. Danh từ: accountability.
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (adjective): answerable for results. "Be accountable for X" means you must answer for X. Noun: accountability.

items.question: Trong câu "The most useful way to tell them apart is not memorising definitions but asking the four different questions each role answers.", từ "tell apart" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most useful way to tell them apart is not memorising definitions but asking the four different questions each role answers.", what does "tell apart" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tell apart /tel əˈpɑːt/ (cụm từ): phân biệt. "Tell A and B apart" = phân biệt A với B. Tương tự: distinguish between A and B.
items.explanationEn: tell apart /tel əˈpɑːt/ (phrase): to see the difference between. "Tell A and B apart" means to distinguish them. Similar: distinguish between A and B.

items.question: Trong câu "The most useful way to tell them apart is not memorising definitions but asking the four different questions each role answers.", từ "memorise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most useful way to tell them apart is not memorising definitions but asking the four different questions each role answers.", what does "memorise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: memorise /ˈmeməraɪz/ (động từ): học thuộc lòng. "Memorise definitions" = học thuộc định nghĩa. Cách viết Mỹ: memorize.
items.explanationEn: memorise /ˈmeməraɪz/ (verb): to learn by heart. "Memorise definitions" means to learn them by heart. US spelling: memorize.

items.question: Trong câu "The business owner cares about money and business benefit.", từ "care about" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business owner cares about money and business benefit.", what does "care about" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: care about /keər əˈbaʊt/ (cụm từ): quan tâm đến. "Care about X" = coi X là quan trọng; khác với "care for" = chăm sóc.
items.explanationEn: care about /keər əˈbaʊt/ (phrase): to consider important. "Care about X" means X matters to you; "care for" means to look after.

items.question: Trong câu "The business owner cares about money and business benefit.", từ "benefit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business owner cares about money and business benefit.", what does "benefit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: benefit /ˈbenɪfɪt/ (danh từ): lợi ích. "Business benefit" = lợi ích kinh doanh; "employee benefits" lại là phúc lợi nhân viên.
items.explanationEn: benefit /ˈbenɪfɪt/ (noun): an advantage or gain. "Business benefit" is the gain for the business; "employee benefits" are staff perks.

items.question: Trong câu "The Product Owner cares about the order and value of each item.", từ "value" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Product Owner cares about the order and value of each item.", what does "value" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: value /ˈvæljuː/ (danh từ): giá trị (đem lại). "The value of each item" = giá trị mà mỗi hạng mục mang lại; "values" (số nhiều) còn là giá trị đạo đức.
items.explanationEn: value /ˈvæljuː/ (noun): usefulness or worth. "The value of each item" is how much it is worth to users; "values" can also mean principles.

items.question: Trong câu "The project manager cares about plan, resources, and risk.", từ "resource" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project manager cares about plan, resources, and risk.", what does "resource" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (danh từ): nguồn lực. "Resources" trong dự án = người, tiền, thời gian, thiết bị. Cụm: allocate resources (phân bổ nguồn lực).
items.explanationEn: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (noun): people, money or time available. In a project, "resources" are people, money, time and equipment. Collocation: allocate resources.

items.question: Trong câu "The project manager cares about plan, resources, and risk.", từ "risk" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project manager cares about plan, resources, and risk.", what does "risk" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: risk /rɪsk/ (danh từ): rủi ro. "Manage risk" = quản lý rủi ro. Tính từ: risky, high-risk (rủi ro cao).
items.explanationEn: risk /rɪsk/ (noun): the chance of something bad. "Manage risk" means handling possible problems. Adjectives: risky, high-risk.

items.question: Trong câu "The business owner (or business sponsor) is accountable for the BUSINESS OUTCOME the investment must deliver.", từ "sponsor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business owner (or business sponsor) is accountable for the BUSINESS OUTCOME the investment must deliver.", what does "sponsor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a senior backer of a project
items.explanation: sponsor /ˈspɒnsə(r)/ (danh từ): người bảo trợ (dự án). "Business sponsor" = người cấp cao đứng ra bảo trợ và cấp vốn cho dự án; nghĩa khác là nhà tài trợ sự kiện.
items.explanationEn: sponsor /ˈspɒnsə(r)/ (noun): a senior backer of a project. A "business sponsor" is a senior person who backs and funds a project; it can also mean an event funder.

items.question: Trong câu "The business owner (or business sponsor) is accountable for the BUSINESS OUTCOME the investment must deliver.", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business owner (or business sponsor) is accountable for the BUSINESS OUTCOME the investment must deliver.", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊtkʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả. "Business outcome" = kết quả kinh doanh đạt được, khác với "output" (sản phẩm đầu ra).
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊtkʌm/ (noun): a result. A "business outcome" is the result achieved, as opposed to an "output" (the thing produced).

items.question: Trong câu "The business owner (or business sponsor) is accountable for the BUSINESS OUTCOME the investment must deliver.", từ "investment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business owner (or business sponsor) is accountable for the BUSINESS OUTCOME the investment must deliver.", what does "investment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: money put in to gain a return
items.explanation: investment /ɪnˈvestmənt/ (danh từ): khoản đầu tư. "The investment must deliver an outcome" = khoản đầu tư phải mang lại kết quả. Động từ: invest in.
items.explanationEn: investment /ɪnˈvestmənt/ (noun): money put in to gain a return. "The investment must deliver an outcome" means it must pay off. Verb: invest in.

items.question: Trong câu "Approve the budget and decide whether to keep investing.", từ "approve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Approve the budget and decide whether to keep investing.", what does "approve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approve /əˈpruːv/ (động từ): phê duyệt. "Approve the budget" = phê duyệt ngân sách. Danh từ: approval (sự phê duyệt).
items.explanationEn: approve /əˈpruːv/ (verb): to officially accept. "Approve the budget" means to officially accept it. Noun: approval.

items.question: Trong câu "Approve the budget and decide whether to keep investing.", từ "budget" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Approve the budget and decide whether to keep investing.", what does "budget" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: budget /ˈbʌdʒɪt/ (danh từ): ngân sách. "Within budget" = trong phạm vi ngân sách; "over budget" = vượt ngân sách.
items.explanationEn: budget /ˈbʌdʒɪt/ (noun): money planned for a purpose. "Within budget" means not spending more than planned; "over budget" means exceeding it.

items.question: Trong câu "Define the business objectives the product must serve.", từ "objective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define the business objectives the product must serve.", what does "objective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: objective /əbˈdʒektɪv/ (danh từ): mục tiêu. Là danh từ, "objective" = mục tiêu; là tính từ lại nghĩa là "khách quan".
items.explanationEn: objective /əbˈdʒektɪv/ (noun): a goal to achieve. As a noun "objective" means a goal; as an adjective it means unbiased.

items.question: Trong câu "Define the business objectives the product must serve.", từ "serve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define the business objectives the product must serve.", what does "serve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: serve /sɜːv/ (động từ): phục vụ (mục đích). "Serve an objective" = phục vụ, góp phần đạt mục tiêu; nghĩa khác là dọn đồ ăn cho khách.
items.explanationEn: serve /sɜːv/ (verb): to help achieve. "Serve an objective" means to help achieve it; another sense is to bring food to guests.

items.question: Trong câu "Answer to senior leadership for the benefits realised.", từ "answer to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Answer to senior leadership for the benefits realised.", what does "answer to" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to reply to a letter from
items.explanation: answer to /ˈɑːnsə tuː/ (cụm từ): chịu trách nhiệm trước. "Answer to someone for something" = phải báo cáo, chịu trách nhiệm trước ai về việc gì.
items.explanationEn: answer to /ˈɑːnsə tuː/ (phrase): to be responsible to. "Answer to someone for something" means to be held responsible to them for it.

items.question: Trong câu "Answer to senior leadership for the benefits realised.", từ "senior leadership" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Answer to senior leadership for the benefits realised.", what does "senior leadership" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: senior leadership /ˈsiːniə ˈliːdəʃɪp/ (cụm từ): ban lãnh đạo cấp cao. "Senior" ở đây = cấp cao (senior management), không phải "người cao tuổi".
items.explanationEn: senior leadership /ˈsiːniə ˈliːdəʃɪp/ (phrase): top executives of a company. "Senior" here means high-ranking (senior management), not elderly.

items.question: Trong câu "Answer to senior leadership for the benefits realised.", từ "realise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Answer to senior leadership for the benefits realised.", what does "realise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: realise /ˈriːəlaɪz/ (động từ): đạt được, hiện thực hóa. "Benefits realised" = lợi ích đã thực sự đạt được; nghĩa phổ biến khác là "nhận ra". Mỹ: realize.
items.explanationEn: realise /ˈriːəlaɪz/ (verb): to achieve, to make real. "Benefits realised" are gains actually achieved; the common other sense is to become aware. US: realize.

items.question: Trong câu "Unblock at organizational level when internal politics stall the project.", từ "stall" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unblock at organizational level when internal politics stall the project.", what does "stall" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stall /stɔːl/ (động từ): làm đình trệ. "Stall the project" = làm dự án bị đình trệ. Danh từ "stall" còn nghĩa là quầy hàng.
items.explanationEn: stall /stɔːl/ (verb): to stop from progressing. "Stall the project" means to stop it moving. As a noun "stall" can also mean a market stand.

items.question: Trong câu "Unblock at organizational level when internal politics stall the project.", từ "politics" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unblock at organizational level when internal politics stall the project.", what does "politics" (noun) mean?
options: đấu đá quyền lực nội bộ
items.explanation: politics /ˈpɒlətɪks/ (danh từ): đấu đá quyền lực nội bộ. "Internal politics / office politics" = chuyện tranh giành ảnh hưởng trong tổ chức; khác "policy" (chính sách).
items.explanationEn: politics /ˈpɒlətɪks/ (noun): power struggles inside a group. "Internal politics" or "office politics" are struggles for influence; do not confuse with "policy".

items.question: Trong câu "Clear, measurable business objectives", từ "measurable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clear, measurable business objectives", what does "measurable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: measurable /ˈmeʒərəbl/ (tính từ): đo lường được. "Measurable objectives" = mục tiêu đo được bằng số liệu, như "giảm 30% cuộc gọi hỗ trợ".
items.explanationEn: measurable /ˈmeʒərəbl/ (adjective): able to be measured. "Measurable objectives" can be checked with numbers, such as cutting support calls by 30 percent.

items.question: Trong câu "Sponsorship when another department's process must change.", từ "sponsorship" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sponsorship when another department's process must change.", what does "sponsorship" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sponsorship /ˈspɒnsəʃɪp/ (danh từ): sự bảo trợ, hậu thuẫn. Khi quy trình của phòng ban khác phải thay đổi, cần "sponsorship" = sự hậu thuẫn từ người có thẩm quyền.
items.explanationEn: sponsorship /ˈspɒnsəʃɪp/ (noun): backing and support. When another department must change, you need sponsorship: backing from someone with authority.

items.question: Trong câu "A high-risk warning sign: nobody can name the business owner, or that person never appears.", từ "warning sign" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A high-risk warning sign: nobody can name the business owner, or that person never appears.", what does "warning sign" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a sign that trouble may come
items.explanation: warning sign /ˈwɔːnɪŋ saɪn/ (cụm từ): dấu hiệu cảnh báo. "A warning sign" = dấu hiệu báo trước vấn đề. Tương tự: red flag.
items.explanationEn: warning sign /ˈwɔːnɪŋ saɪn/ (phrase): a sign that trouble may come. "A warning sign" signals a coming problem. Similar: red flag.

items.question: Trong câu "Then nobody has authority to resolve inter-departmental conflict, and the project gets stuck at the political layer.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then nobody has authority to resolve inter-departmental conflict, and the project gets stuck at the political layer.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒrəti/ (danh từ): thẩm quyền. "Have authority to do X" = có thẩm quyền làm X; "the authorities" (số nhiều) = cơ quan chức năng.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒrəti/ (noun): the power to decide. "Have authority to do X" means having the power to do it; "the authorities" means officials.

items.question: Trong câu "Then nobody has authority to resolve inter-departmental conflict, and the project gets stuck at the political layer.", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then nobody has authority to resolve inter-departmental conflict, and the project gets stuck at the political layer.", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): giải quyết. "Resolve a conflict" = giải quyết xung đột; "resolve to do X" lại là quyết tâm làm X.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to settle, to solve. "Resolve a conflict" means to settle it; "resolve to do X" means to decide firmly.

items.question: Trong câu "Then nobody has authority to resolve inter-departmental conflict, and the project gets stuck at the political layer.", từ "get stuck" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then nobody has authority to resolve inter-departmental conflict, and the project gets stuck at the political layer.", what does "get stuck" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to be unable to move forward
items.explanation: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (cụm từ): bị mắc kẹt, bế tắc. "The project gets stuck" = dự án bị bế tắc, không tiến được. Tương tự: stall.
items.explanationEn: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (phrase): to be unable to move forward. "The project gets stuck" means it cannot progress. Similar: stall.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most confused pair, and the boundary varies most by company.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most confused pair, and the boundary varies most by company.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "The boundary between two roles" = ranh giới trách nhiệm giữa hai vai trò.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (noun): a dividing line. "The boundary between two roles" is where one role's responsibility ends.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most confused pair, and the boundary varies most by company.", từ "vary" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most confused pair, and the boundary varies most by company.", what does "vary" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vary /ˈveəri/ (động từ): khác nhau, thay đổi. "Vary by company" = khác nhau tùy công ty. Tính từ: various, variable.
items.explanationEn: vary /ˈveəri/ (verb): to differ. "Vary by company" means to be different from one company to another. Related: various, variable.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: being pulled toward the urgent (backlog) and neglecting the important (strategy).", từ "urgent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: being pulled toward the urgent (backlog) and neglecting the important (strategy).", what does "urgent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: urgent /ˈɜːdʒənt/ (tính từ): khẩn cấp. "The urgent vs the important" = việc gấp và việc quan trọng; dễ bị việc gấp cuốn đi.
items.explanationEn: urgent /ˈɜːdʒənt/ (adjective): needing action now. "The urgent vs the important": pressing tasks tend to crowd out important ones.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: being pulled toward the urgent (backlog) and neglecting the important (strategy).", từ "neglect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: being pulled toward the urgent (backlog) and neglecting the important (strategy).", what does "neglect" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fail to give attention to
items.explanation: neglect /nɪˈɡlekt/ (động từ): lơ là, bỏ bê. "Neglect strategy" = bỏ bê chiến lược. Tính từ: negligent (cẩu thả).
items.explanationEn: neglect /nɪˈɡlekt/ (verb): to fail to give attention to. "Neglect strategy" means not giving it attention. Adjective: negligent.

items.question: Trong câu "The PM owns strategy and market; the PO owns execution with the team.", từ "execution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PM owns strategy and market; the PO owns execution with the team.", what does "execution" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: execution /ˌeksɪˈkjuːʃn/ (danh từ): việc thực thi. "Strategy vs execution" = chiến lược và thực thi. Nghĩa khác (pháp lý) là thi hành án tử hình.
items.explanationEn: execution /ˌeksɪˈkjuːʃn/ (noun): carrying out a plan. "Strategy vs execution": deciding versus doing. In law it can also mean putting someone to death.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: the PO becomes a pure backlog administrator, disconnected from the business reasoning.", từ "disconnected" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: the PO becomes a pure backlog administrator, disconnected from the business reasoning.", what does "disconnected" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disconnected /ˌdɪskəˈnektɪd/ (tính từ): tách rời, mất kết nối. "Disconnected from X" = không còn gắn kết, không hiểu X. Cũng dùng cho mạng: bị ngắt kết nối.
items.explanationEn: disconnected /ˌdɪskəˈnektɪd/ (adjective): cut off from. "Disconnected from X" means cut off from it; for networks it means the connection dropped.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: the PO becomes a pure backlog administrator, disconnected from the business reasoning.", từ "reasoning" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: the PO becomes a pure backlog administrator, disconnected from the business reasoning.", what does "reasoning" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reasoning /ˈriːzənɪŋ/ (danh từ): lập luận, lý lẽ. "Business reasoning" = lý lẽ kinh doanh đằng sau quyết định. Động từ: reason (lập luận).
items.explanationEn: reasoning /ˈriːzənɪŋ/ (noun): the thinking behind a decision. "Business reasoning" is the logic behind decisions. Verb: reason.

items.question: Trong câu "the team may be executing very efficiently in the wrong direction.", từ "efficiently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the team may be executing very efficiently in the wrong direction.", what does "efficiently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: efficiently /ɪˈfɪʃntli/ (trạng từ): một cách hiệu quả. "Efficiently" = làm tốt, không lãng phí; khác "effectively" = làm đúng việc, đạt mục tiêu.
items.explanationEn: efficiently /ɪˈfɪʃntli/ (adverb): without wasting effort. "Efficiently" means without waste; "effectively" means achieving the right goal.

items.question: Trong câu "A project manager is accountable for delivering a project with a defined scope, deadline, and resources.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project manager is accountable for delivering a project with a defined scope, deadline, and resources.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi (công việc). "Defined scope" = phạm vi công việc đã xác định. Cụm: scope creep (phạm vi phình dần).
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the range of work included. "Defined scope" is the agreed range of work. Related: scope creep.

items.question: Trong câu "A project manager is accountable for delivering a project with a defined scope, deadline, and resources.", từ "deadline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project manager is accountable for delivering a project with a defined scope, deadline, and resources.", what does "deadline" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deadline /ˈdedlaɪn/ (danh từ): hạn chót. "Meet / miss a deadline" = kịp / trễ hạn chót.
items.explanationEn: deadline /ˈdedlaɪn/ (noun): the latest time to finish. "Meet / miss a deadline" means to finish on time / late.

items.question: Trong câu "Negotiate a contract change, adjust schedule and resources", từ "negotiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Negotiate a contract change, adjust schedule and resources", what does "negotiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: negotiate /nɪˈɡəʊʃieɪt/ (động từ): đàm phán. "Negotiate a contract change" = đàm phán thay đổi hợp đồng. Danh từ: negotiation.
items.explanationEn: negotiate /nɪˈɡəʊʃieɪt/ (verb): to discuss to reach agreement. "Negotiate a contract change" means to discuss terms until both sides agree. Noun: negotiation.

items.question: Trong câu "Negotiate a contract change, adjust schedule and resources", từ "adjust" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Negotiate a contract change, adjust schedule and resources", what does "adjust" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (động từ): điều chỉnh. "Adjust the schedule" = điều chỉnh lịch trình. Danh từ: adjustment.
items.explanationEn: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (verb): to change slightly. "Adjust the schedule" means to alter it a little. Noun: adjustment.

items.question: Trong câu "In organizations running pure Scrum, the project manager role usually gets decomposed", từ "decompose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In organizations running pure Scrum, the project manager role usually gets decomposed", what does "decompose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decompose /ˌdiːkəmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): chia tách thành phần nhỏ. Ở đây vai trò được "decomposed" = chia nhỏ cho nhiều người; nghĩa sinh học là phân hủy.
items.explanationEn: decompose /ˌdiːkəmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to break into smaller parts. Here the role is decomposed, split among several people; in biology it means to rot.

items.question: Trong câu "But in practice, especially on contracted outsourced projects, the project manager role remains essential.", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But in practice, especially on contracted outsourced projects, the project manager role remains essential.", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. "In theory ... but in practice ..." = về lý thuyết ... nhưng thực tế ...
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (phrase): in reality. "In theory ... but in practice ..." contrasts the idea with what really happens.

items.question: Trong câu "But in practice, especially on contracted outsourced projects, the project manager role remains essential.", từ "outsourced" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But in practice, especially on contracted outsourced projects, the project manager role remains essential.", what does "outsourced" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: outsourced /ˈaʊtsɔːst/ (tính từ): thuê ngoài. "Outsourced projects" = dự án gia công, thuê công ty ngoài làm. Động từ: outsource.
items.explanationEn: outsourced /ˈaʊtsɔːst/ (adjective): done by an external company. "Outsourced projects" are done by an outside vendor. Verb: outsource.

items.question: Trong câu "But in practice, especially on contracted outsourced projects, the project manager role remains essential.", từ "essential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But in practice, especially on contracted outsourced projects, the project manager role remains essential.", what does "essential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: essential /ɪˈsenʃl/ (tính từ): thiết yếu. "Remain essential" = vẫn thiết yếu. Trạng từ: essentially (về cơ bản).
items.explanationEn: essential /ɪˈsenʃl/ (adjective): absolutely necessary. "Remain essential" means to still be necessary. Adverb: essentially.

items.question: Trong câu "Somebody must manage the customer commitment, budget, risk, and reporting — and Scrum defines no role for that.", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Somebody must manage the customer commitment, budget, risk, and reporting — and Scrum defines no role for that.", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪtmənt/ (danh từ): cam kết. "Customer commitment" = những gì đã cam kết với khách hàng. Động từ: commit to.
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪtmənt/ (noun): a promise to do something. "Customer commitment" is what has been promised to the client. Verb: commit to.

items.question: Trong câu "The project manager wants scope locked; the Product Owner wants flexibility.", từ "locked" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project manager wants scope locked; the Product Owner wants flexibility.", what does "locked" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: locked /lɒkt/ (tính từ): cố định, chốt lại. "Scope locked" = phạm vi đã chốt, không được đổi; nghĩa đen là khóa cửa bằng chìa.
items.explanationEn: locked /lɒkt/ (adjective): fixed, not open to change. "Scope locked" means frozen against change; literally it means fastened with a key.

items.question: Trong câu "The project manager wants scope locked; the Product Owner wants flexibility.", từ "flexibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project manager wants scope locked; the Product Owner wants flexibility.", what does "flexibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: flexibility /ˌfleksəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): sự linh hoạt. Tính từ: flexible (linh hoạt). Trái nghĩa: rigid (cứng nhắc).
items.explanationEn: flexibility /ˌfleksəˈbɪləti/ (noun): the ability to change easily. Adjective: flexible. Opposite: rigid.

items.question: Trong câu "The nature of it: a trade-off between short-term growth and long-term delivery capability.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The nature of it: a trade-off between short-term growth and long-term delivery capability.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "A trade-off between A and B" = sự đánh đổi giữa A và B, được cái này mất cái kia.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two gains. "A trade-off between A and B" means gaining one costs some of the other.

items.question: Trong câu "The nature of it: a trade-off between short-term growth and long-term delivery capability.", từ "nature" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The nature of it: a trade-off between short-term growth and long-term delivery capability.", what does "nature" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: nature /ˈneɪtʃə(r)/ (danh từ): bản chất. "The nature of the conflict" = bản chất của xung đột; nghĩa khác là thiên nhiên.
items.explanationEn: nature /ˈneɪtʃə(r)/ (noun): the basic character of something. "The nature of the conflict" is what it basically is; the other sense is the natural world.

items.question: Trong câu "The nature of it: a trade-off between short-term growth and long-term delivery capability.", từ "capability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The nature of it: a trade-off between short-term growth and long-term delivery capability.", what does "capability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capability /ˌkeɪpəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): năng lực. "Delivery capability" = năng lực bàn giao sản phẩm của đội. Tính từ: capable of.
items.explanationEn: capability /ˌkeɪpəˈbɪləti/ (noun): the ability to do something. "Delivery capability" is the team's ability to ship. Adjective: capable of.

items.question: Trong câu "The product manager wants features for a new market; the Product Owner sees technical debt blocking delivery.", từ "technical debt" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The product manager wants features for a new market; the Product Owner sees technical debt blocking delivery.", what does "technical debt" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: technical debt /ˈteknɪkl det/ (cụm từ): nợ kỹ thuật. "Technical debt" = các lối tắt trong code khiến thay đổi sau này tốn kém hơn. Cụm: pay down technical debt.
items.explanationEn: technical debt /ˈteknɪkl det/ (phrase): cost of shortcuts in code. "Technical debt" is shortcuts in code that make later changes costlier. Collocation: pay down technical debt.

items.question: Trong câu "agree in advance which part of scope is fixed (usually the business outcome and the deadline) and which is flexible (how that outcome is achieved).", từ "in advance" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "agree in advance which part of scope is fixed (usually the business outcome and the deadline) and which is flexible (how that outcome is achieved).", what does "in advance" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (cụm từ): trước (thời điểm đó). "Agree in advance" = thống nhất từ trước. Tương tự: beforehand, ahead of time.
items.explanationEn: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (phrase): beforehand. "Agree in advance" means to agree beforehand. Similar: ahead of time.

items.question: Trong câu "agree in advance which part of scope is fixed (usually the business outcome and the deadline) and which is flexible (how that outcome is achieved).", từ "achieve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "agree in advance which part of scope is fixed (usually the business outcome and the deadline) and which is flexible (how that outcome is achieved).", what does "achieve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: achieve /əˈtʃiːv/ (động từ): đạt được. "Achieve an outcome / a goal" = đạt được kết quả / mục tiêu. Danh từ: achievement.
items.explanationEn: achieve /əˈtʃiːv/ (verb): to succeed in reaching. "Achieve an outcome / a goal" means to reach it. Noun: achievement.

items.question: Trong câu "for example, how much estimates for similar changes have risen over six months.", từ "estimate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "for example, how much estimates for similar changes have risen over six months.", what does "estimate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈestɪmət/ (danh từ): ước tính. Danh từ /ˈestɪmət/ = con số ước tính; động từ /ˈestɪmeɪt/ = ước tính. Estimates tăng dần là dấu hiệu nợ kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈestɪmət/ (noun): a rough calculation. Noun /ˈestɪmət/ is a rough figure; verb /ˈestɪmeɪt/ means to calculate roughly. Rising estimates signal technical debt.

items.question: Trong câu "The business owner enforces a deadline; the team says it is not feasible.", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business owner enforces a deadline; the team says it is not feasible.", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): áp đặt, buộc tuân theo. "Enforce a deadline / a rule" = áp đặt, buộc tuân thủ hạn chót / quy định.
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make people obey. "Enforce a deadline / a rule" means to make people comply with it.

items.question: Trong câu "The business owner enforces a deadline; the team says it is not feasible.", từ "feasible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business owner enforces a deadline; the team says it is not feasible.", what does "feasible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: feasible /ˈfiːzəbl/ (tính từ): khả thi. "Not feasible" = không khả thi. Danh từ: feasibility study (nghiên cứu khả thi).
items.explanationEn: feasible /ˈfiːzəbl/ (adjective): possible to do. "Not feasible" means it cannot realistically be done. Noun: feasibility study.

items.question: Trong câu "deadlines usually attach to a real business event (peak season, a compliance date).", từ "attach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "deadlines usually attach to a real business event (peak season, a compliance date).", what does "attach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (động từ): gắn với. "Attach to an event" = gắn liền với một sự kiện; nghĩa quen thuộc khác là đính kèm tệp email.
items.explanationEn: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (verb): to be connected to. "Attach to an event" means to be linked with it; the familiar other sense is adding a file to an email.

items.question: Trong câu "deadlines usually attach to a real business event (peak season, a compliance date).", từ "peak season" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "deadlines usually attach to a real business event (peak season, a compliance date).", what does "peak season" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: peak season /piːk ˈsiːzn/ (cụm từ): mùa cao điểm. "Peak season" = mùa cao điểm; trái nghĩa: off-peak / low season.
items.explanationEn: peak season /piːk ˈsiːzn/ (phrase): the busiest time of year. "Peak season" is the busiest period; opposite: off-peak or low season.

items.question: Trong câu "deadlines usually attach to a real business event (peak season, a compliance date).", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "deadlines usually attach to a real business event (peak season, a compliance date).", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ (quy định). "Compliance date" = hạn phải tuân thủ một quy định. Động từ: comply with. Đừng nhầm với compliment (lời khen).
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (noun): following rules or laws. "Compliance date" is when a regulation must be met. Verb: comply with. Do not confuse with compliment.

items.question: Trong câu "do not argue about the deadline — present scope options.", từ "argue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "do not argue about the deadline — present scope options.", what does "argue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: argue /ˈɑːɡjuː/ (động từ): tranh cãi. "Argue about X" = tranh cãi về X; "argue that ..." = lập luận rằng ...
items.explanationEn: argue /ˈɑːɡjuː/ (verb): to disagree in words. "Argue about X" means to dispute it; "argue that ..." means to give reasons for a view.

items.question: Trong câu "establish who has the authority in that situation, give them the data, and accept their decision.", từ "establish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "establish who has the authority in that situation, give them the data, and accept their decision.", what does "establish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: establish /ɪˈstæblɪʃ/ (động từ): xác định rõ. "Establish who decides" = xác định rõ ai quyết định; nghĩa khác là thành lập tổ chức.
items.explanationEn: establish /ɪˈstæblɪʃ/ (verb): to find out for certain. "Establish who decides" means to make it certain; the other sense is to found an organization.

items.question: Trong câu "Prolonged conflict usually stems not from missing information but from nobody being clear on who decides.", từ "prolonged" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prolonged conflict usually stems not from missing information but from nobody being clear on who decides.", what does "prolonged" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: prolonged /prəˈlɒŋd/ (tính từ): kéo dài. "Prolonged conflict" = xung đột kéo dài. Động từ: prolong (kéo dài).
items.explanationEn: prolonged /prəˈlɒŋd/ (adjective): lasting a long time. "Prolonged conflict" goes on for a long time. Verb: prolong.

items.question: Trong câu "Prolonged conflict usually stems not from missing information but from nobody being clear on who decides.", từ "stem from" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prolonged conflict usually stems not from missing information but from nobody being clear on who decides.", what does "stem from" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: stem from /stem frɒm/ (cụm từ): bắt nguồn từ. "X stems from Y" = X bắt nguồn từ Y. Danh từ "stem" = thân cây.
items.explanationEn: stem from /stem frɒm/ (phrase): to be caused by. "X stems from Y" means Y is the cause of X. As a noun, "stem" is a plant stalk.

items.question: Trong câu "The four roles overlap and every company defines them differently — ask rather than assume.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four roles overlap and every company defines them differently — ask rather than assume.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): cho rằng, giả định. "Ask rather than assume" = hãy hỏi thay vì tự cho là vậy; "assume a role" lại là đảm nhận vai trò.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to suppose without checking. "Ask rather than assume" means check instead of guessing; "assume a role" means to take it on.

items.question: Trong câu "The most useful distinction is the four different central questions each role answers.", từ "distinction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most useful distinction is the four different central questions each role answers.", what does "distinction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋkʃn/ (danh từ): sự phân biệt. "Draw a distinction between A and B" = phân biệt A và B; "with distinction" = loại xuất sắc.
items.explanationEn: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋkʃn/ (noun): a difference drawn between things. "Draw a distinction between A and B" means to separate them; "with distinction" means with honours.

items.question: Trong câu "BAs and POs need measurable business objectives from the business owner, not slogans.", từ "slogan" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs and POs need measurable business objectives from the business owner, not slogans.", what does "slogan" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: slogan /ˈsləʊɡən/ (danh từ): khẩu hiệu. "Not slogans" = không phải những câu khẩu hiệu chung chung, mà là mục tiêu đo được.
items.explanationEn: slogan /ˈsləʊɡən/ (noun): a catchy phrase. "Not slogans" means not vague catchphrases but measurable goals.

items.question: Trong câu "A PO manages an evolving product; a project manager manages a project with a start and an end.", từ "evolving" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PO manages an evolving product; a project manager manages a project with a start and an end.", what does "evolving" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: evolving /ɪˈvɒlvɪŋ/ (tính từ): không ngừng phát triển. "An evolving product" = sản phẩm liên tục thay đổi, phát triển. Động từ: evolve; danh từ: evolution.
items.explanationEn: evolving /ɪˈvɒlvɪŋ/ (adjective): changing and growing over time. "An evolving product" keeps changing and growing. Verb: evolve; noun: evolution.

items.question: Trong câu "The four roles answer four different questions at four different time horizons, and that is the most reliable way to tell them apart.", từ "time horizon" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four roles answer four different questions at four different time horizons, and that is the most reliable way to tell them apart.", what does "time horizon" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the line where sky meets land
the period a plan looks ahead
items.explanation: time horizon /taɪm həˈraɪzn/ (cụm từ): khung thời gian (tầm nhìn). "Time horizon" = khoảng thời gian mà một vai trò/kế hoạch hướng tới; "horizon" nghĩa đen là chân trời.
items.explanationEn: time horizon /taɪm həˈraɪzn/ (phrase): the period a plan looks ahead. "Time horizon" is how far ahead a role or plan looks; literally "horizon" is where sky meets land.

items.question: Trong câu "The four roles answer four different questions at four different time horizons, and that is the most reliable way to tell them apart.", từ "reliable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four roles answer four different questions at four different time horizons, and that is the most reliable way to tell them apart.", what does "reliable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reliable /rɪˈlaɪəbl/ (tính từ): đáng tin cậy. "The most reliable way" = cách đáng tin cậy nhất. Động từ: rely on; danh từ: reliability.
items.explanationEn: reliable /rɪˈlaɪəbl/ (adjective): able to be trusted. "The most reliable way" is the one you can trust most. Verb: rely on; noun: reliability.
